title: Session behavior through PgBouncer
question: A statement prepared in one transaction cannot be found in the next. Did the pooler run the next transaction on a different PostgreSQL server connection?

controls.purpose: DEALLOCATE ALL on a direct connection produces the same 26000 with no pooler involved.
A statement timeout produces a different error, 57014, so a timeout is not mistaken for this problem.

competingExplanations: The connector or application reset the session
A timeout was mistaken for a pooling limitation
The prepared operation itself is invalid
A customer application sent this workflow through a transaction pool
stillToBuild: More workflows, including cases where the operation itself is invalid
